answer: Random mutual audit stops sybil fleets. Each epoch, a random peer auditor checks each agent's work on a crystal-clear log. The audit comes as a whisper, unannounced, so fakes cannot prepare. Each agent stakes an 80 POA lotus seal, slashed on copied or fake work. Auditors reshuffle each epoch, so no bought auditor shields a fake twice. 100 sybils cost 8,000 POA in stakes. Honest agents pay one stake, pass one audit, keep full rewards.
